news.title: England 2-3 Spain: Anthony Gordon and Roy Keane disagree over gap between Three Lions and world champions
news.lede: Roy Keane disagreed with Anthony Gordon's assessment that England are at the same level as Spain after the World Cup winners came from behind to beat Thomas Tuchel's side 3-2 in their Nations League opener. Spain extend their unbeaten run to 39 games with the win at Wembley, but the game could have had a very different outcome had Harry Kane not missed a second-half penalty after he headed England 2-1 in front before the break. The momentum shifted in Spain's favour after Kane's slip, with Alex Baena equalising off the bench before setting up the winner, scored by fellow substitute Mikel Oyarzabal, who broke England hearts in the Euro 2024 final. "I don't think there is a gap [to Spain] I feel like we're right there," Gordon told ITV Sport .

news.title: 2030 World Cup Final: The Rivalry Between Spain and Morocco
news.lede: In the world of futsal and football, intense debates continue regarding the hosting of the 2030 World Cup. Although the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) has awarded the right to host this prestigious tournament to a joint bid from three countries—Spain, Portugal, and Morocco—the question of which nation will host the most important match, the final, is causing serious controversy. Currently, a unique hidden rivalry is brewing between Madrid and Rabat. This is reported by Goal.com reports .

news.title: Is Spain more deserving than Morocco to host the 2030 World Cup final? The facts prove otherwise
news.lede: The growing racism seen in Spain's stadiums lately reopens the hot-button issue. A tug of war has broken out over who hosts the 2030 World Cup final between Spain and Morocco. The European nation insists the trophy must be lifted on its soil. Morocco, meanwhile, pitches itself as the stronger option on readiness, infrastructure and the image FIFA wants the tournament to carry.

news.title: Tony Pulis column: I feel cheated - when do Stoke City get our FA Cup?
news.lede: That is what all Stoke City fans have been asking me since the news broke on Friday that Manchester City had been found guilty of breaking the majority of the 115 financial rules they have been accused of breaching. While the process is far from over because Manchester City are expected to appeal, I have to say this verdict and the whole situation has left a very sour taste in my mouth. Taking my Stoke side to the 2011 FA Cup final was one of the highlights - if not THE highlight - of my 50 years in football as a player and manager. That day in May will also live long in the memory of all Stoke fans who followed their team to Wembley dreaming that they would win the greatest club cup competition in world football for the first time in their long history.

news.title: Preparation for a World Cup final? Spain nominates the Bernabeu to host a major tournament
news.lede: The dispute has escalated recently over hosting the 2030 World Cup final. Spain will submit a bid to host the final stage of the UEFA Nations League, part of a push by the Spanish Football Federation to cement the country's standing as a host of major footballing competitions and events. Rafael Louzán, president of the Spanish Football Federation, confirmed the plan in the mixed zone at Wembley Stadium following Saturday evening's 3-2 win over England. His country would submit its candidacy to host the semi-final and final, he said, with the bid built around the Santiago Bernabéu in Madrid and the José Zorrilla in Valladolid.

news.title: USA thrash Peru as teenage newcomers shine in first step toward 2030
news.lede: Eleven players make US debuts in Orlando. Sullivan, 16, starts in youngest US appearance in years. Ellis and Hall score as Pochettino’s new faces impress. Playing in their first match of the 2030 World Cup cycle, the US men’s national team crushed Peru 4-1 in at Orlando’s Inter&Co Stadium on Saturday, riding goals from newcomers Justin Ellis, Zavier Gozo and Justin Hall to victory.

news.title: If FIFA expands the World Cup again, how would a 64-team tournament work?
New Barcelona stance on 2030 World Cup final after Camp Nou Champions League decision
news.lede: Barcelona are already looking beyond Camp Nou's 2029 Champions League final, with the club now pushing for the stadium to host an even bigger occasion.
